detail.longDescription: Now also available in English: Two UPS units in my homelab. But the real question wasn't who stays on, it was: what comes back up when the power returns? 🤔 Long test with the whole house: 16 minutes on battery, clean shutdown, and everything running again 6 minutes after the power came back. Hands-off. Only the "power back" push notification arrived while the power was still out... :-D https:// tim-bartel.de/ups-for-the-home lab/ # homelab # selfhosted # proxmox # homeassistant
